items.name: Prologue
items.tip: Michael and Trevor: a bank job in the snow goes badly wrong. The game starts here.

items.name: Franklin and Lamar
items.tip: Franklin and Lamar race each other to repo two sports cars.

items.name: Repossession
items.tip: Help Lamar repo a motorbike for Simeon. Expect a fight.

items.name: Complications
items.tip: Franklin repos a car from a big house in the hills and meets Michael.

items.name: Chop
items.tip: Chase down a gang member with Chop the dog.

items.name: Father/Son
items.tip: Michael chases a stolen yacht on the highway to save his son.

items.name: Marriage Counseling
items.tip: Michael and Franklin chase a man and pull down a house on the hillside.

items.name: Daddy's Little Girl
items.tip: Michael races his daughter on bikes and in the sea.

items.name: Friend Request
items.tip: Michael deals with his son's online life. Short and funny.

items.name: The Long Stretch
items.tip: Franklin backs up Lamar at a deal that turns into a shootout.

items.name: Casing the Jewel Store
items.tip: Scout the jewellery store with smart glasses before the heist.

items.name: Bugstars Equipment
items.tip: Steal a pest-control van and gear to use as a disguise.

items.name: The Jewel Store Job
items.tip: The first big heist: rob the jewellery store, then escape.

items.name: Mr. Philips
items.tip: Meet Trevor in the desert. He takes on the bikers.

items.name: Trevor Philips Industries
items.tip: Trevor attacks a rival gang's base.

items.name: Nervous Ron
items.tip: Trevor and Ron take out a rival gang from afar.

items.name: Crystal Maze
items.tip: Trevor blows up a gang's meth lab.

items.name: Friends Reunited
items.tip: Trevor tracks Michael down in the city.

items.name: Fame or Shame
items.tip: Michael and Trevor chase a man at a TV talent show.

items.name: Dead Man Walking
items.tip: Michael, Trevor and Franklin pull a body out of a morgue.

items.name: Three's Company
items.tip: All three grab a target from a building. Rappel, snipe and chase.

items.name: By the Book
items.tip: A dark interrogation mission with Trevor and Michael.

items.name: Hood Safari
items.tip: Franklin and Trevor visit the hood and things get loud.

items.name: Scouting the Port
items.tip: Trevor scouts the docks while doing crane work.

items.name: Minisub
items.tip: Steal a mini submarine for the port heist.

items.name: The Merryweather Heist
items.tip: Steal cargo from a ship or a sub. You pick the approach.

items.name: Blitz Play
items.tip: Rob an armoured truck with a garbage-truck roadblock.

items.name: Caida Libre
items.tip: Michael chases a plane from the sky.

items.name: Deep Inside
items.tip: Michael steals a car from a film set.

items.name: Paleto Score Setup
items.tip: Plan the rural bank job and grab the gear.

items.name: The Paleto Score
items.tip: Rob the rural bank in heavy armour and fight your way out.

items.name: Predator
items.tip: Hunt a target with a helicopter and night vision.

items.name: Monkey Business
items.tip: Steal a chemical weapon from a lab with a cargo plane.

items.name: Hang Ten
items.tip: Franklin follows up a lead on the big score.

items.name: Surveying the Score
items.tip: Scout the gold vault for the final heist.

items.name: The Bureau Raid
items.tip: Break into a government office to steal files.

items.name: The Wrap Up
items.tip: A huge shootout at a building site.

items.name: Lamar Down
items.tip: Save Lamar from a sawmill ambush.

items.name: Meltdown
items.tip: Michael's plot with a film producer ends hard.

items.name: The Big Score
items.tip: The final heist: steal tons of gold. Pick obvious or subtle.

items.name: Something Sensible
items.tip: Ending A: Franklin has to deal with Trevor.

items.name: The Time's Come
items.tip: Ending B: Franklin has to deal with Michael.

items.name: The Third Way
items.tip: Ending C (Deathwish): the three team up against everyone.

items.name: Grass Roots
items.tip: Help Barry with his weed campaign. Leads to wild trips.

items.name: Pulling Favors
items.tip: Snap celebrity photos for a paparazzo.

items.name: Exercising Demons
items.tip: Race a fitness fanatic: running, cycling and swimming.

items.name: Shift Work
items.tip: Do towing jobs for Tonya.

items.name: Seeking the Truth
items.tip: Join a strange cult and follow its odd tasks.

items.name: Paparazzo
items.tip: Chase celebrities with a camera for big shots.

items.name: The Last One
items.tip: Hunt a legendary creature in the woods. Needs 100%.

items.name: Rampage
items.tip: Trevor goes on timed rampages against gangs.

items.name: Nigel and Mrs. Thornhill
items.tip: Help two superfans grab celebrity items.

items.name: Fanatic
items.tip: More races against the fitness fanatic.

items.name: Tonya
items.tip: Tow cars for Tonya when her boyfriend is out.

items.name: Hao
items.tip: Street races for a tuner shop owner.

items.name: Barry
items.tip: Barry needs help with his weed campaign.

items.name: Maude
items.tip: Catch bail jumpers for Maude: alive pays more.
